description.value:
You have an eye for the ideal jewelry needed for any occasion. In 10 minutes, you can craft the perfect accessories for one creature for one social event. The accessories confer a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] at that event. A creature can only have one set of accessories per day, and they go out of style after 24 hours and can no longer be used. The accessories have negligible monetary value.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Atraxid Jewelry]
